index_alignment: all price-volume inputs are shifted by one session and applied to the current open
purge_embargo: 21-bar label horizon plus 21-bar embargo in every chronological fold
factor_selection_scope: rank-IC scoring and correlation pruning are recomputed from each fold training frame only
sample_data_caveats: the six-date historical challenge is not a pristine lockbox
notes: AI factors improved matched LambdaRank and ElasticNet models in development, but no standalone model or ensemble beat deterministic 12-1 in the exposed historical challenge. A1/A2 remain forward diagnostic challengers.
